---
title: "Conflict and well-being of civilians: The case of the Russian-Ukrainian hybrid war"
description: "Economic Systems, 2020. With Maryna Osiichuk."
date: "2020-01-01"
status: "published"
categories: [ukraine]
---

Using survey data collected before and after the outbreak of hybrid warfare
in eastern Ukraine in 2014, we estimate the effect of proximity to conflict
on self-reported well-being and economic security — evidence that
predates, and helps contextualise, the much larger shock of the 2022
full-scale invasion.

**Published in:** *Economic Systems*, 44(1)
